g.text: I02 Benchmarking uses the same worker protocol on a pinned population.
I04 Structured Muse arbitration is a separate optional call over a bound Assessment.
Experts CLI uses measured routing even without an agent. Direct Python inference bypasses routing.
Executable repair checks and multi-round campaign supervision have separate entry points.
